name: Tangará (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red over green, charged at the centre with a white lozenge bearing the municipal arms.
history: Tangará is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 12 November 1971 (created with the arms by Municipal Law No. 565 of 12 November 1971, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with grapes, a cogwheel and a landscape, reading TANGARÁ
